title: Send idempotency key when creating payment intents
body: Passes the cart id as an idempotency key so double-clicking Pay can't create two intents. Also moves env lookups behind a small `readEnv` helper.

nodes.body: Nice, this has bitten us before.

## Pull request overview

Adds an idempotency key to payment intent creation and introduces a `readEnv` helper.

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
